Privacy Policy for CVtoMatch

Effective Date: October 16, 2026  |  Website: https://www.cvtomatch.com

CVtoMatch ("we", "our", or "us") operates the AI Career Intelligence & Resume Matching platform at https://www.cvtomatch.com. This Privacy Policy describes how CVtoMatch collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects your personal information and Google user data when you use our website and services.

1. Information We Collect

  • Account & Google Sign-In Information: When you register or sign in using Google OAuth (openid, email, profile), we collect your full name and email address to create and authenticate your CVtoMatch workspace account.
  • Resume / CV Documents: When you upload a resume (PDF, DOCX, or TXT), we store the extracted text and document file in your private account so you can compute ATS match scores, generate tailored cover letters, and attach your resume to job applications you initiate.
  • Optional Gmail Outreach Integration: If you explicitly connect your Gmail account in Settings (scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send) or configure SMTP credentials, we store an encrypted OAuth refresh token or SMTP configuration solely to send job application emails that you explicitly compose and trigger.
  • Application Tracker Data: Job postings, companies, notes, and application statuses you save in your Kanban pipeline tracker.
  • Analytics & Diagnostics: Aggregate, anonymized usage analytics (Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity) to improve site reliability and user experience.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information strictly to provide, maintain, and improve CVtoMatch features requested by you:

  • Authenticating your identity and maintaining your login session across visits.
  • Calculating 6-factor NLP resume-to-job match scores and keyword gap diagnostics.
  • Generating tailored resumes and cover letters for specific job descriptions you select.
  • Sending job application and follow-up emails on your behalf only when you click Send or Auto-Apply.
  • Organizing your job applications in your personal Kanban tracker.

3. Google API Services User Data Policy & Limited Use Compliance

CVtoMatch's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements:

  • Send-Only Gmail Scope: When you connect Gmail via OAuth, CVtoMatch only requests the gmail.send scope to dispatch job application emails that you explicitly initiate. CVtoMatch does not read, scan, or share your personal Gmail inbox via Google OAuth.
  • No Sale of Data: We never sell, rent, license, or trade your personal data, uploaded resumes, or Google user data to third parties, data brokers, or advertisers.
  • No Advertising or AI Foundation Model Training: Google user data is never used for serving advertisements or for training generalized third-party AI models.
  • Human Access Restrictions: No human at CVtoMatch reads your Google user data unless we have your affirmative agreement for a specific support request, or as required for security/legal compliance.

4. Data Storage, Security & Retention

All communication between your browser, our servers, and Google APIs is encrypted over HTTPS/TLS. Passwords are salted and hashed using industry-standard bcrypt. We retain your account data and uploaded CV only for as long as your account remains active or until you delete them.

5. Data Sharing & Third-Party Disclosures

We do not share your personal data or Google user data with third parties except: (a) when you explicitly instruct CVtoMatch to send an application email with your resume attached to a specific recruiter email address you selected, or (b) when required to comply with applicable law.

6. Your Rights, Revoking Access & Data Deletion

  • Disconnect Google / Gmail at Any Time: You can disconnect your Gmail integration in one click inside Settings → Email / Gmail Setup → Disconnect, or revoke CVtoMatch's access directly from your Google Account Permissions page.
  • Access, Update, or Delete Your Data: You may update your profile or request complete deletion of your CVtoMatch account, uploaded resumes, and stored tokens at any time by emailing us at yassineyoussefwx@gmail.com. Deletion requests are processed within 48 hours.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact:
